_authority: This package is a derived distribution of the BANZA v1.0.0 public normative surface. It is not an independent specification. The BANZA Normative Manifest remains authoritative.
_reference_implementation: The reference implementation is intentionally excluded.
_construction: Built by positive allowlist from the Phase D implementation set for this profile. No file is present unless the allowlist selected it; nothing is copied and then deleted.

the assistant. The first trial must prove the package suffices without human or machine assistance from us
secrets and runtime state; no private key material exists in this repository and none is exported

not_required: Live payment rails of any kind
Wallets, transfers or a ledger — those are L1
Payment requests, QR or instant execution — those are L2
Federation, cross-operator routing or settlement — those are L3
External payment-network integration — that is L4
Trust material of your own: no signing key, no key manifest, no published metadata. L0 needs no identity and no signature
Any registration, submission, approval or credential from any party
